name: TwistingData.p_dvd_cj_frobenius_sub
summary: Modulo p, x ↦ x^{P^d} is a ring homomorphism f, and π∘ι_s = f∘ι_{s−d} (Frobenius congruence); so modulo p the conjugation by ι_s(h) and the P^d-th power of the conjugation by ι_{s−d}(h⁻¹) cancel.

steps.claim: Let π : O → O/(p) be the quotient map.
Let f = π∘(x ↦ x^{P^d}), a ring homomorphism O → O/(p): additive by the binomial theorem in characteristic p (P^d is a power of p).
steps.lean:
let f := RingHom.mk' (π.1.comp (powMonoidHom _)) (by
    simp [← pow_mul, add_pow_prime_pow_eq T.prime, π, -map_natCast])

steps.claim: The claim says π((letterConj …)_{bc}) = π(Y_{bc})^{P^d} = f(Y_{bc}); it follows from the matrix identity π(ι_s(h)·(ι_{s−d}(h⁻¹)Yι_{s−d}(h))^{(P^d)}·ι_s(h⁻¹)) = f(Y), obtained by rewriting with the two facts below and cancelling f(ι_{s−d}(h⁻¹))·f(ι_{s−d}(h)) = 1.
steps.lean:
(eq_zero_iff_dvd ..).1 (sub_eq_zero.2 (congrFun₂ ((by simp [← RingHom.coe_comp, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_assoc (Y.map _), show π ∘ (· ^ _) = f by rfl, show π.comp _ = f.comp
    _ by ext; simpa [← eq_zero_iff_dvd] using! T.frobenius_pow_congr d (s - d) _]) : .map _ π =
    Y.map f) ..))

steps.claim: π∘ι_s = f∘ι_{s−d} as ring homomorphisms W → O/(p): ι_s(x) ≡ ι_{s−d}(x)^{P^d} mod p (frobenius_pow_congr with d steps from s − d).
steps.lean:
show π.comp _ = f.comp
    _ by ext; simpa [← eq_zero_iff_dvd] using! T.frobenius_pow_congr d (s - d) _]) : .map _ π =
    Y.map f) ..))
